name: TrackWith Dicloud
author: Dicloud

sections.description:
Introducing Privacy-Friendly Visitor Tracking WordPress Plugin!

TrackWith for WordPress is designed to empower WordPress website owners with valuable insights into their site’s traffic, all while prioritizing user privacy and data protection. With a simple installation process, you can easily monitor visitor activity without compromising on ethical data practices.
Hosted in EU, built on privacy-first principles, our plugin ensures that no personally identifiable information is collected from visitors, making it compliant with stringent privacy regulations. Rest assured, your users’ data remains confidential, fostering trust and transparency.
Gain access to key analytics, such as page views, unique visitors, and popular content, helping you make data-driven decisions to enhance user experiences and optimize your site’s performance. The customizable dashboard provides clear visualizations, giving you a comprehensive overview of your website’s traffic patterns.
Experience the power of insightful data without sacrificing your visitors’ privacy. Download TrackWith for WordPress plugin today and embark on a journey towards a more secure and user-centric website.

Main features

  • Easy to use
  • One-click integration without any code
  • All data stored safely in EU
  • Track visitors session & replay visitor sessions
  • Detailed visitor analytic
  • Page heatmaps
  • Goals tracking
  • Simplified analytic dashboard

Third-Party Services

This plugin integrates with TrackWith Dicloud, a third-party analytics service. The plugin sends visitor data to TrackWith’s servers to provide analytics functionality.

Service Information:
* Service Provider: TrackWith Dicloud (https://trackwith.dicloud.net)
* Data Processing: Visitor analytics and tracking data
* Service Terms: https://dicloud.net/terms/
* Privacy Policy: https://dicloud.net/privacy/

Data Transmission:
This plugin transmits visitor analytics data to TrackWith Dicloud servers to provide website analytics functionality. The data includes page views, visitor sessions, and other analytics metrics. No personally identifiable information is collected or transmitted.

Service Requirements:
To use this plugin, you must have a TrackWith Dicloud account and API key. The plugin will not function without proper authentication to the TrackWith service.
sections.faq:
Whats the different between Lightweight & Advanced tracking mode?

Lightweight tracking is designed for individuals who prioritize privacy and prefer a simple and high performance tracking solution.
Advanced tracking is tailored for individuals who seek more comprehensive analytics and wish to gain deeper insights into their visitors’ behavior.
